instagram:
This one was on paper. I didn't know that when I took it.

I thought I was trading my funded account. The plan on that account is only $400 to $500 a day toward payout. So when my long on 2 ES from 7,505.50 reached 7,510.50, I sold both: 5 points each, +$500 before fees.

The worst the position got was about 2.25 points against me, inside my hard stop of 3.5 to 4 points from entry.

The last frame is the 15 minute chart from this afternoon. After my exit, ES dropped to around 7,420.

Paper account, before fees.

facebook:
Paper trade today, and I'll be honest about why I got out where I did.

I bought 2 ES at 7,505.50 thinking I was on my prop firm account. On that account my plan to reach a payout is $400 to $500 a day, nothing more. At 7,510.50 the trade was worth $500, so I sold both contracts.

It turned out to be my paper account. The funded plan got followed anyway.

At its worst the trade sat a little over 2 points red, well inside the hard stop I use on every trade, 3.5 to 4 points from where I get in. By the afternoon, ES had fallen roughly 90 points to near 7,420.

Paper account, before fees.
